scope: Read-only installed source and existing raw, plus extracted-class pure code probe. No CLI/provider calls, no frozen modifications.

cause.classification: Native print resume versus ACP pre-prompt control/event lifecycle difference; not random model behavior.
mechanism: Media registrar initially refreshes, then subscribes only to AgentStatusUpdated and runtime change; media registration depends on image/video capability.
Session replay executes events silently and skips observable event publication; registrar does not subscribe to restore-complete.
Native resumed launches pass same model and get effort from identical config. setModel with unchanged alias is no-op; first resumed HTTP request lacks ReadMediaFile.
ACP driver explicitly sets thinking before each prompt. setThinking always dispatches config/status even unchanged, refreshing registrar before request.
Live token-count measurement/status can refresh registrar after first model response, consistent with all second requests restoring ReadMediaFile.
cause.confidence: Source mechanisms and existing per-request pattern strongly support this lifecycle explanation. Extracted class reproduces stale registration until status event. No new instrumented full CLI run; exact first live refresh trigger on each historical turn is not independently traced.

minimalRecommendations: Do not remove native tools, add task prompts, or alter provider install to force parity.
